WITH web_v1 as ( select ws_item_sk item_sk, d_date, sum(sum(ws_sales_price)) over (partition by ws_item_sk order by d_date rows between unbounded preceding and current row) cume_sales from web_sales ,date_dim where ws_sold_date_sk=d_date_sk and d_month_seq between 1212 and 1212+11 and ws_item_sk is not NULL group by ws_item_sk, d_date), store_v1 as ( select ss_item_sk item_sk, d_date, sum(sum(ss_sales_price)) over (partition by ss_item_sk order by d_date rows between unbounded preceding and current row) cume_sales from store_sales ,date_dim where ss_sold_date_sk=d_date_sk and d_month_seq between 1212 and 1212+11 and ss_item_sk is not NULL group by ss_item_sk, d_date), web_daily AS (
    SELECT ws_item_sk AS item_sk, d_date, SUM(ws_sales_price) AS web_daily
    FROM web_sales, date_dim
    WHERE ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
      AND d_month_seq BETWEEN 1212 AND 1212+11
      AND ws_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ws_item_sk, d_date
), store_daily AS (
    SELECT ss_item_sk AS item_sk, d_date, SUM(ss_sales_price) AS store_daily
    FROM store_sales, date_dim
    WHERE ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
      AND d_month_seq BETWEEN 1212 AND 1212+11
      AND ss_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ss_item_sk, d_date
), combined AS (
    SELECT item_sk, d_date,
           SUM(web_daily) AS web_daily,
           SUM(store_daily) AS store_daily,
           MAX(has_web) AS has_web,
           MAX(has_store) AS has_store
    FROM (
        SELECT item_sk, d_date, web_daily, NULL::numeric AS store_daily, 1 AS has_web, 0 AS has_store
        FROM web_daily
        UNION ALL
        SELECT item_sk, d_date, NULL::numeric AS web_daily, store_daily, 0 AS has_web, 1 AS has_store
        FROM store_daily
    ) u
    GROUP BY item_sk, d_date
)
SELECT item_sk, d_date,
       CASE WHEN has_web = 1 THEN web_cume ELSE NULL END AS web_sales,
       CASE WHEN has_store = 1 THEN store_cume ELSE NULL END AS store_sales,
       web_cume AS web_cumulative,
       store_cume AS store_cumulative
FROM (
    SELECT item_sk, d_date, has_web, has_store,
           SUM(web_daily) OVER (PARTITION BY item_sk ORDER BY d_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS web_cume,
           SUM(store_daily) OVER (PARTITION BY item_sk ORDER BY d_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS store_cume
    FROM combined
) y
WHERE web_cume > store_cume
ORDER BY item_sk, d_date
LIMIT 100
